intro: Sudan is where the Blue Nile and White Nile meet, at Khartoum.

chapters.title: Nile, desert and savanna
text: The north is Sahara and Nubian desert. The two Niles join at Khartoum and flow north to Egypt. The south has savanna, and the Marra Mountains rise in Darfur.
Sudan has a Red Sea coast around Port Sudan.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The north is extremely hot and dry; the south gets summer rains.
